CustomField.description: Boolean formula that returns TRUE when TotalGiftsAmount meets or exceeds the Mid.Lifetime_Min_Amount__c value in FQS_Donor_Grouping custom metadata. Thresholds are configured via Setup → Custom Metadata Types → FQS Donor Grouping or the FQS Setup screen flow. Changing threshold values in Setup or via the FQS Setup flow recalculates this field across all Donor Gift Summary records retroactively — no redeployment or batch job required. Reports and dashboards using this field will reflect the new values immediately.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculated. The field is checked when this donor's total lifetime giving qualifies for the Mid donor grouping. Your administrator controls the threshold amount.
CustomField.label: Is Mid Lifetime Donor
